output.brief: The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. Flag eligibility requires build 7.4.0, so flagged users are all on 7.4.0 and unflagged users are mostly on 7.3.2. Build 7.4.0 crashed at about 2% from 2 Sep, before the flag ramp started. Build 7.3.2 stayed at about 0.7%. Within 7.4.0, flag-on users (2.10%) and the random flag-off holdout (1.98%) barely differ, and that difference is within noise. The top crash cluster, about 41% of events, is a native crash in the Pixelda image library upgraded in 7.4.0. It appears in both Tracewell and the app store's separate crash counts, so it is not just a reporting artifact. Device mix, usage intensity and the 9 Sep sync-service deploy don't explain it. A small flag effect, a few tenths of a point, can't be ruled out yet. Don't turn the flag off and close the incident, and don't push 7.4.0 to 100%. Hold the rollout at 25%. Prioritise a fix for the Pixelda HEIF decode crash. Keep the flag and holdout running to measure any residual flag effect. Widening the holdout would speed that up. Don't roll back the crash-reporting SDK.
